watched #Cirkus : ONE TIME WATCH!!! a typical Rohit Shetty’s Comedy with Over The Top forceful comedy and overacting characters….Kids and few audience will like this comedy but for others this will sound unbearable!!!! But thats how Rohit Shetty’s school of comedy works

Personally I love different genres and respect the fact that each and every director has their own style, I generally make sure that I cache clear my mind for every movie and try to watch and enjoy it irrespective of the my own liking or disliking as I know before hand what I should expect from certain type Directors or Production Houses!!!

Following the same I enjoy Rohit Shetty’s over the top comedy (mind you not double meaning or vulgar – though there is no proper definition for it) and enjoyed All the Best, Golmaal Series and Bol Bachchan etc….but Cirkus unfortunately couldn’t work for me as there we minimal laughs and also the comedy scenes which worked out had given me a feel that I have watched this somewhere and that too in Rohit Shetty’s movie only, may be this is due to the fact that he repeats all his comic actors a lot and for similar kind of roles 😞

Ranvir was effortless in this movie and Jacqueline was uselesss 😉
